hack.root_cause: Flash Loan — LP Token Price Manipulation (Price Threshold Bypass)
hack.description: Gamma Strategies lost $4.5M when an attacker used flash loans to push prices to the edges of Gamma's own intentionally-set price tolerance thresholds — the "protection" mechanism was the vulnerability because the tolerances were set too wide.
